title: Wholesome Dutch Lentils Stamppot
description: A classic Dutch dish featuring buttery, snappy sautéed lentils and kale, served with a side of boiled potatoes and a pat of butter.
instructions: Heat a large pot of water over high heat, then add the potatoes and cook until they are tender.
While the potatoes cook, heat the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and sauté until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the green lentils to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are lightly browned.
Add the kale to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is wilted.
Add the water, chicken broth, salt, and pepper to the pot with the lentils and kale, then bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
While the lentils simmer, mash the cooked potatoes with a fork and add the grainy mustard.
To serve, place a scoop of the mashed potatoes on a plate, then top with a scoop of the lentils and kale.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Serve with an additional pat of butter on the side, if desired.
